shortDescription: Brazil's auto production rose in August from the previous month, while sales fell slightly, data released by automakers' association Anfavea showed on Tuesday.According to Anfavea, production was up 6.8% last month to 271,100 units, while sales dropped 1.6% to 275,100 units.

According to Anfavea, production was up 6.8% last month to 271,100 units, while sales dropped 1.6% to 275,100 units.
